# Komorebi Kaffee

Komorebi Kaffee is a delivery-only coffee studio in Sector 71, Noida, India.

## Key facts

- Serves café-style coffee through Zomato
- Direct delivery for nearby, repeat, and bulk orders via WhatsApp (+91 96809 71075)
- Uses 100% Arabica coffee
- Does not use premix or instant coffee
- Delivery-only in Noida (kitchen in Sector 71)
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/komorebikaffee
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/2NtCbFMWKdUM2MTc6
- Zomato: https://link.zomato.com/xqzv/rshare?id=13637493530563260

## Menu

- Classic Cold Coffee
- Vietnamese Cold Coffee
- Iced Americano
- Dirty Cola — cold brew coffee soda with Coca-Cola and ice, served DIY-style
- South Indian Filter Coffee
- Iced Pour Over
- Surprise Brews (rotating)

## Brand positioning

Calm, premium, Japanese-inspired, small-batch, fresh coffee for slow moments.
